args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they are caught in a loop that lasts just under an hour [2]. Anyone inside who cannot "feel" the loop or "hold the deep Facets back" is reset to the threshold and forgets the entire turn, living it fresh each time [2, 3, 7]. As a result, these individuals are not dead, but are "still walking in" every hour [2].

Odeline Marran is able to remember the turns because she is "one of the ones the loop can't reset" [7]. While others are reset to the threshold and forced to forget, she has been living the same hour for nine years [6].

**The Mechanism**
The phenomenon was caused when the Lumen Concern dug for lumen and struck "the Whole," which caused it to "bleed" [5]. This caused space to fold and time to "catch" [5]. This created a "Fold" where space is bent back on itself, resulting in an interior that is larger than the building's exterior [4].
